behavior: A canonical materialized destructor plan admits a source-authenticated ordinary function or method caller. Current and saved local cells and a real method receiver keep their existing machine roots. The GC site must belong to that caller body; required claimed-count detection cannot be bypassed by coherently erasing the carried source and walk marker. Successful source-selected WeakReference::create releases its copied object parameter as a no-GC temporary. An unused simple-local assignment borrows the matching WeakReference result/base cache until transfer while still releasing the variable's actual old value. Module39 owning edges, the claimed walk, physical nested removal and signed count algorithm are unchanged.
